summary: Iteration 2 backend regression + new-feature tests: 53/53 pytest cases PASS (100%) when run sequentially. Coverage: 19 Aveiro concelhos seeded, school cascade by grade (EB1 ↔ Secundária), SEO sitemap.xml + tracking + robots.txt, PUT settings persists SEO IDs (super_admin only), voucher PDF upload (PDF magic-byte check, ~8MB cap, admin-only download via FileResponse, 401 without token), expanded Aveiro postcode geofence (3700/3800 → true, 1000 → false), orders hand_delivery 3700 OK / 1000 blocked, admin enrich-covers, partners with logo_url+promo_code, auth/me, brute-force lockout (now correctly fires at 5 fails → 429). Discovered and patched 4 iteration-1 regressions in tests (see action_items / critical_code_review_comments).

minor.issue: Hard cap of limit=200 server-side (line 435 server.py). With 291 seeded books, a client requesting limit=500 silently receives only 200 items. Frontend catalog and external sitemap generators need to paginate (use `page` / `pages` from response). Currently iteration 1's test had to switch to using `total` from the paginated response.

8 submissions/hour per identifier is enforced. When pytest-xdist runs vouchers tests in parallel, the limit triggers cross-test and breaks the suite. Tests now run serially OR pre-clear db.voucher_submissions. No fix needed in product code — limit is correct.
Still no authentication on order creation; customer_email is trusted from the request body (carried over from iteration 1).
Still no stock_qty decrement on order creation (carried over from iteration 1).

integration_issues.issue: BREAKING CHANGE: /api/books now returns paginated `{items,total,page,page_size,pages}` instead of a flat list (was a list in iteration 1). Frontend code that does `books.map(...)` directly on the response will break. Tester confirmed by reproducing — please audit all frontend fetches of /api/books and switch to `.items`.
affected_selectors: /api/books consumers in CatalogPage / HomePage / Wishlist UI

action_items: Confirm frontend was updated to consume the new paginated /api/books shape ({items,total,page,...}). If not, the catalog/home/wishlist pages will silently render nothing.
Document the 200-item server-side cap on /api/books (and expose pagination controls in the UI).
Consider raising the voucher rate-limit identifier to include user.id when authenticated, so a logged-in admin testing the flow isn’t blocked by a previous IP throttle.
Add authentication requirement (or HMAC) to POST /api/orders to prevent order spam.
Add stock_qty decrement when an order moves to 'paid' to avoid overselling.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 2024 lines (was 983 in iteration 1). 3× the soft limit. Strongly recommend splitting into routers: auth.py, books.py, schools.py, orders.py, vouchers.py, seo.py, admin.py.
VOUCHER_MAX_BYTES is 8MB (server.py:45) but the iteration spec mentioned 5MB — keep in sync with the product copy on the UI.

PUT /api/admin/settings now requires super_admin (server.py:1652). Iteration 1 test used standard admin and broke; the test was updated to use super_token. Confirm the AdminSettings UI hides the form for non-super users (no API-level fallback exists).
/api/seo/sitemap.xml does not include lastmod per book (uses today’s date for every URL). Acceptable for now, but Google may demote relevance — consider storing books.updated_at and reflecting it.

robots.txt at /app/frontend/public uses an absolute `Sitemap: /api/seo/sitemap.xml` directive — Google requires a fully qualified URL. Recommend rewriting to `Sitemap: https://<site_url>/api/seo/sitemap.xml` (templated at build time or served dynamically by the backend).

POST /api/vouchers/upload stores files under ROOT_DIR/private_storage/vouchers without atomic write (open-write-flush). On a crash mid-write the DB row will reference a corrupt PDF. Use tempfile + rename().

_check_voucher_rate_limit uses request.client.host when unauthenticated — same K8s-ingress quirk as the brute-force bug from iteration 1. Today this is the safe side (over-limit, not under), but worth aligning on a single sourced-IP helper (X-Forwarded-For-aware).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (adapted to paginated /api/books shape; switched settings test to super_token; switched store_pickup to hand_delivery+3800; used raw requests.post for multipart import)

success_rate.backend: 100% (53/53) when pytest is run serially. Parallel runs hit the voucher rate limit cross-test (8/hour) and may report 4–6 false negatives in the voucher suite — pre-clear db.voucher_submissions or run with `pytest -o addopts=` to disable xdist for full clean run.

seed_data_creation: All test data prefixed TEST_ (emails, ISBNs 9999*, voucher codes, municipality/school names). Cleanup runs implicitly via DELETE in CRUD test and finally-blocks in SEO settings test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run sequentially: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v -o addopts=` (omits xdist; xdist breaks the voucher rate-limit suite). Before any voucher test, optionally pre-clear: `python -c "from pymongo import MongoClient; MongoClient('mongodb://localhost:27017')['test_database'].voucher_submissions.delete_many({})"`. The single biggest finding is the BREAKING CHANGE on /api/books (list → {items, total, ...}); next agent should specifically confirm the React frontend renders the paginated shape correctly. The brute-force lockout that failed in iteration 1 NOW PASSES — main agent fixed the identifier logic.
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration 1 → 2 broke several existing tests because /api/books switched from returning `List[Book]` to a paginated dict `{items, total, page, page_size, pages}` (server.py:401-448). The contract change is undocumented and silently truncates any unpaginated consumer at 200 rows (limit cap line 435). All five iteration-1 books tests, the cart tests, two order tests, and the wishlist test crashed with `KeyError: 0` / `TypeError: string indices must be integers` when treating the dict as a list. The test suite was patched with a helper `_books(api, **params)` that handles both shapes. The store_pickup delivery method was removed per requirement #7 ('APENAS entrega em mão'); the iteration-1 test that exercised it was migrated to delivery_method='hand_delivery' + postal_code='3800'. PUT /api/admin/settings was tightened to require super_admin (line 1652); the lamination-price test was repointed to super_token. Finally, the multipart school-books import was failing because the requests.Session in conftest forces `Content-Type: application/json`, which overrode the multipart boundary; the test now uses raw requests.post.
